effects.effect: The gods imbue a divine swiftness within you. Whenever an [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) creature deals damage to you, you can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to a number of squares equal to your [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition) score after the damage is dealt.
